'''Jaden Korr's lightsaber''' was a weapon constructed by Jedi Knight [[Jaden Korr]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].

==History==
===Creation===
In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] Jaden constructed this purple-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in his [[Orn|Uncle's]] workshop while in a dreamlike state. He showed off the lightsaber to a surprised Orn, who immediately contacted the local authorities, and had him enlisted in the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on the moon [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] within two days.<ref name="Riptide" />

===First encounter with the Disciples of Ragnos===
{{Quote|So, where did you get that lightsaber?''"<br />"''Well, it's kind of a long story; I found myself on&hellip;|Rosh Penin and Jaden Korr just moments before their shuttle was attacked|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />}}
During the ride, he met [[Rosh Penin]], who was very impressed with Korr's lightsaber and proceeded to ask him how he got it. Before Jaden could answer, their [[Yavin Runner II|shuttle]] was shot down by members of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] cult as it approached the surface. After the crash, Korr and Penin were separated from the rest of the students and proceeded to the nearby [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi temple]], Korr used his lightsaber to cut a few trees down to make bridges and they fought several howlers. Eventually they ran into some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and a member of the cult. After Korr defeated the cultist he investigated the temple. He saw three figures, one of which was holding a glowing [[Scepter of Ragnos|scepter]]; they were later revealed to be the [[Kothos twins]] and [[Tavion Axmis]] using the scepter to drain [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from the temple. However, Jaden's eavesdropping efforts were detected, and the mysterious figures turned on him, knocking him out.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

===Jedi apprentice===
{{Quote|A Jedi, me? No, not yet, I'm one of Kyle Katarn's students.|Jaden Korr to Chewbacca|audio=AJediMeNoNotYet-JediAcademy.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />}}
Upon awakening, Jaden met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and Luke Skywalker, who welcomed their new student to the academy and questioned him about what he saw. Shortly afterward, he and Rosh were assigned to Kyle as pupils, and they passed their standard Force abilities course. On the way, Rosh set loose a [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|lightsaber practice droid]] upon Jaden in the hope of slowing him down so he could finish the course first, but Jaden defeated the droid. After the training, Kyle admonished Rosh heavily for this careless decision, stating that it was not a competition and that if the droid had been set to Skywalker's training module, it would've killed Jaden. Feeling guilty, Penin apologized for the incident. Jaden was angry that Rosh could do such a thing, but Kyle warned him not to feed his anger, and Jaden accepted Rosh's apology.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

[[File:Blenjeel_Jedi_Academy.jpg|thumb|200px|One of Jaden's early [[Mission to Blenjeel|missions]], at Blenjeel.]]
Korr and Penin were sent on a series of missions, helping to track down the growing cult. Jaden visited various [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], including [[Mission to Blenjeel|Blenjeel]], [[Mission to Corellia (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Corellia]], [[Mission to Tatooine (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Tatooine]], [[Mission to Chandrila|Chandrila]] and [[Mission to Bakura (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Bakura]]. Although Katarn went with Jaden on most of his missions, due to unexpected events, all of Jaden's missions were more hazardous than expected. Through them all, Jaden kept a cool head and came out on top.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

Later, Master Skywalker summoned all available [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to inform them that&mdash;during the downed shuttle crisis&mdash;someone had sliced into his records and stolen his journal containing names of places where he had found a very strong connection to the Force. Worried of what the slicer could be planning, he sent the Jedi to various places mentioned in his journal. Jaden [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|went to]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where Master Skywalker had had a vision of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

[[File:Missiontohoth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jaden landing on Hoth.]]
Upon landing on the planet, Korr couldn't sense anything out of place there, but as soon as he started investigating, he found that the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperials]] were guarding [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. Jaden infiltrated the base and overheard a [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultist]] talking on a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], Tavion Axmis's apprentice, about Skywalker having traveled to Dagobah after the battle.
Korr defeated the Cultist and confronted Alora. The two engaged in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber duel]], and were at first evenly matched. After Jaden began to gain the upper hand, Alora escaped through a caved-in section of Echo Base, taunting Jaden as she left. The accounts were documented in Korr and Katarn's [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] report entitled [[Tauntaun Feathers A1]].<ref name="hui">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}}</ref>

Rosh was [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] during his [[Mission to Byss (Rosh Penin)|mission]] to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], and Katarn spent time looking for him. Jaden, now promoted to Apprentice, worked on more missions, until Master Skywalker assigned the Jedi to investigate other strong Force sensitive places that weren't mentioned in his journals. The Jedi students were instructed to work in pairs because of Rosh's capture. Kyle and Jaden were assigned to [[Mission to Vjun (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|investigate]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

[[File:JadenVsAlora.jpg|thumb|200px|Jaden confronts Alora in Echo Base]]
Katarn and Korr infiltrated the fortress, but soon after became separated. Alone and ahead of Kyle, Jaden fought his way through the fortress, finally confronting none other than Rosh Penin in Vader's throne room. Rosh had turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] following his capture. He boasted of the power of the dark side to Jaden, and&mdash;along with the [[Kothos twins]]&mdash;engaged him in battle. The battle seemed impossible to win, as the twins kept empowering Rosh with life energy. However, Jaden killed the Twins, hoping that Rosh would stand down without their influence. Nevertheless, Rosh kept on fighting, causing Jaden's anger towards him to build again. After Jaden defeated Penin, Katarn reached the room. As Rosh lay disarmed on the floor, Tavion chose that moment to appear, declaring her part in the Cult. After rebuking Katarn, Tavion [[Telekinesis/Legends|ripped]] Jaden's lightsaber from him with the Force, [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|threw]] it at the heavy ceiling and brought the weakened ceiling down on the Jedi with the [[Scepter of Ragnos]], knocking away Jaden's lightsaber in the process. Thanks to Katarn's quick thinking, Korr was able to use Katarn's lightsaber to cut a hole in the floor for both to escape while Kyle held up the tremendously heavy rubble with the Force. Unfortunately, Tavion and Rosh fled. Kyle and Jaden returned to the academy and reported what they discovered and about Tavion. Jaden came up with the theory that Tavion might be using the scepter's power to not only absorb Force energy, but to also discharge the energy to empower and corrupt her followers, which Katarn and Skywalker found highly possible. Skywalker, impressed with Jaden's actions, promoted the young student to the status of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Nevertheless, Kyle warned Jaden that he felt Jaden's anger towards Rosh, and despite being a Jedi Knight, he must still be aware of giving in to the dark side.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

===Recovery===
At some point after the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] Crisis, Jaden recovered his lightsaber from Bast Castle and continued to carry it. In [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]] he used the lightsaber to kill the clone [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]] grown from [[Kam Solusar]]'s [[DNA/Legends|DNA]].<ref name="CC" /> He later gave this lightsaber to his first apprentice [[Marr Idi-Shael]].<ref name="Riptide" />
